detected_issues: [JS003] Anonymous function expression used (prefer modern arrow functions)
changes_made: Replaced function expression with arrow function syntax
findings.why_should_i_care: Arrow functions are more concise and automatically preserve lexical 'this' binding, making callback functions cleaner and less error-prone.

detected_issues: [JS001] Outdated 'var' keyword used (function-scoped, prone to hoisting)
findings.why_should_i_care: 'var' is function-scoped and prone to hoisting bugs. Using 'const' enforces block scoping and guarantees the variable reference won't be reassigned.
